purpose: Bind an exact graph target to target-specific materialization and launch semantics without encoding predecessor identities in the profile.
invariants: All predecessor identities are resolved from the graph mandatory computation closure.
Profiles may define only relative payload paths; absolute dependency paths are forbidden.
A profile binds one exact target_node_id and one stable test alias.
Material roots must be content-addressed and hash-verified before use.
Existing workspaces are reused only after frozen payload verification.
Mutable runtime files such as bytecode caches must be explicitly declared and may not substitute for source authority.
